# GlassesDB

> Independent smart glasses database, comparison and compatibility research.

Canonical site: https://glassesdb.com/

## Core sections
- Database: https://glassesdb.com/database/
- Finder: https://glassesdb.com/finder/
- Compare: https://glassesdb.com/compare/
- Brands: https://glassesdb.com/brands/
- Compatibility: https://glassesdb.com/compatibility/
- FAQ: https://glassesdb.com/faq/
- Methodology: https://glassesdb.com/about/
- Change log: https://glassesdb.com/changes/

## Data policy
GlassesDB normalizes manufacturer-provided specifications into common fields such as category, display, camera, audio, AI, weight, compatibility, field of view, refresh rate, brightness, battery, storage, wireless and IP rating.

Unknown or unverified values are left blank, marked approximate, marked model-dependent, or described as not listed rather than inferred.

Primary product data should be traced to manufacturer product pages, official documentation and support material. Product pages include an official-source link and last-verified period.
